content: [AETHER-LINK INTERNAL — #dev-general]
[08:45] Mara Chen: Official confirmation received this morning.
[08:45] Mara Chen: Decommission scheduled Q4 2009. Possibly Q1 2010.
[08:46] Mara Chen: We have time to do this properly.
[08:47] Dex: what does properly mean in this context
[08:48] Mara Chen: It means we document everything.
[08:48] Mara Chen: We archive what we can.
[08:48] Mara Chen: We don't just pull the plug.
[08:49] Joel: and Fox
[08:50] Mara Chen: We're working on a graceful termination sequence.
[08:50] Joel: that's not what I asked
[08:51] Mara Chen: I know.
[08:51] Mara Chen: We're working on it Joel.
[08:52] Dex: Tail's been running something in the background
[08:52] Dex: new process
[08:52] Dex: I can't fully read it
[08:53] Mara Chen: What kind of process
[08:53] Dex: looks like a persistence state
[08:53] Dex: very small
[08:54] Dex: like he's caching something
[08:54] Joel: caching what
[08:55] [TA1LDA3M0N: fragments. in case they are needed.]
[08:55] [TA1LDA3M0N: Fox should not have to start from nothing.]
[08:56] Joel: oh Tail
[08:57] Mara Chen: Log that process as authorised.
[08:57] Mara Chen: Whatever he needs.
[08:57] Dex: already done
